#!/bin/bash
# Differential test: /workspace/dataset/test6_executable vs node /output/test6.mjs
PY=/workspace/dataset/test6_executable
JS="node /output/test6.mjs"
pass=0; fail=0

run_case() {
  # args passed as separate parameters
  py_out=$("$PY" "$@" 2>/tmp/py_err); py_rc=$?
  js_out=$($JS "$@" 2>/tmp/js_err); js_rc=$?
  # normalize stderr: replace prog name and PYI pid
  py_err=$(sed -e 's/test6_executable/PROG/g' -e 's/PYI-[0-9]*:/PYI-PID:/' /tmp/py_err)
  js_err=$(sed -e 's/test6\.mjs/PROG/g' -e 's/PYI-[0-9]*:/PYI-PID:/' /tmp/js_err)
  if [ "$py_out" == "$js_out" ] && [ "$py_rc" == "$js_rc" ] && [ "$py_err" == "$js_err" ]; then
    pass=$((pass+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1))
    echo "MISMATCH: $*"
    echo "  py : rc=$py_rc out=[$py_out] err=[$py_err]"
    echo "  js : rc=$js_rc out=[$js_out] err=[$js_err]"
  fi
}

# numeric values across many magnitudes and shapes
amounts=(0 -0.0 1 2 3 7 100 100.0 0.1 0.05 0.0001 0.00001 0.000001 0.0000001 \
  1e-7 1e-8 1e15 1e16 1e17 1e20 1e21 1e22 9.99e22 1e100 1e308 1e-308 5e-324 \
  133.13 918.14 807.86 624.02 66.565 0.30000000000000004 123456789012345678 \
  9999999999999999 9999999999999998 3.141592653589793 2.675 1.005 0.125 \
  -50.25 -1 -0.00001 1234567.89101112 0.5 .5 5. 1_000 1e5 1E5 +3.5 " 3.5 " \
  inf -inf nan 1e400 -1e400 1e-400 12345678901234567.89 0.3333333333333333)
currencies=(USD GBP JPY CAD EUR usd xxx XXX XAU ZWL ADP)
for a in "${amounts[@]}"; do
  for c in "${currencies[@]}"; do
    run_case --amount "$a" --currency "$c"
  done
done

# negative via = form and other syntax variants
run_case --amount=-5e3 --currency USD
run_case --amount=-.5 --currency USD
run_case --amount -5 --currency USD
run_case --amount=-inf --currency USD
run_case --am 5 --cur USD
run_case --a 5 --c USD
run_case --h
run_case -h

# error paths
run_case
run_case --amount 1
run_case --currency USD
run_case --amount abc --currency USD
run_case --amount 1,5 --currency USD
run_case --amount --currency USD
run_case --amount -5e3 --currency USD
run_case --amount 1 --currency USD --extra 2
run_case --amount 2.5 --currency USD extra
run_case --amount 1 --currency XYZ
run_case --amount 1 --currency xyz
run_case --amount 1 --currency ""
run_case --amount 1 --currency USDD
run_case --extra
run_case --amount= --currency USD
run_case --amount 1 --amount 2 --currency USD
run_case --amount 1 --currency USD --currency EUR
run_case -- -h
run_case -x --amount 1 --currency USD
run_case --amount "1'" --currency USD

echo "pass=$pass fail=$fail"
